ai_summary_en: This site (NTU_Dorm_260915) is an urban paved environment. Based on 3D LiDAR and photogrammetry verification, it contains 4 paved roads and walkways covering 953.2 square meters, 11 verified trees with a mean DBH of 31.0 cm, and 38 retaining or building walls with a total vertical area of 546.0 square meters. There are no water bodies or river voids on site.
